program.name: Pilates Posture
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: Pilates for standing tall: spine and back extension, then shoulders and deep core.
program.about: Pilates for better posture. One day strengthens the back and lengthens the spine: swan, swimming, spine stretch and saw. The other works the shoulders and the deep core: leg pull front, the hundred and the stretches, with the shoulders kept down. Both later levels add reps.
